model.meaning: #2941 adapter operation/target/boundary denominator and observation alphabet

source.meaning: Core dispatcher, route implementation, artifact, target, foreign-boundary, fixture, and configuration bytes with exact SHA-256

compiler.meaning: current Jet compiler source/artifact path, proof driver, and pinned compiler-proof identity

checker.meaning: this adapters checker and its shared source-bound checker utilities

configuration.meaning: adapter contract, D-COMPILER-PROOF1 policy, capability relation, and no-execution mode

target.meaning: RustAot, Cranelift, Interpreter, Web, and comptime target applicability and bridge identity

runner.invocation: proof/compiler/adapters/observe.mjs invokes scripts/agent/jet-env full for each selected applicable mode, passes JET_ADAPTER_OBSERVATION_PATH to the selected production, consumes proof/compiler/observations/comparison-journal.mjs records, and replays each typed comparison observation through the canonical jet test-compare path; check.mjs consumes the resulting identity-bound carrier without running Jet
runner.unknown_policy: unknown, unavailable, stale, or unobserved adapter facts remain unverified and cannot become proof

coverage.qualification_rule: every current #2941 row gets one source-bound adapter disposition; failed, stale, unavailable, planned, and unsupported capability rows remain required unless owner-ratified-not-applicable; positive observations may be marked matched but only an approved canonical formal discharge may promote a row to proved

capability_relation.unknown_policy: a missing or unavailable capability row is not an applicable denominator reduction and is reported as unavailable

route_binding.rule: route names are indexes only; a route is bound only when the actual definition and target-specific bridge source are present

tool_configuration.assumption: rustc and LLVM lower the selected RustAot artifact under the recorded target and profile
the assembler and linker consume exactly the emitted RustAot closure
Cranelift compiles only the selected Cranelift artifact and preserves the declared host ABI
the canonical MIR interpreter executes the selected Interpreter artifact under its explicit target layout
rustc and LLVM emit the selected Web Wasm fragment under the recorded wasm target
the named browser or Wasm VM honors the generated ABI and callback contract
comptime uses the canonical evaluator and does not introduce a second semantic policy

foreign_assumptions.edge: RustAot/Web Wasm emitted source to rustc and LLVM
foreign_assumptions.contract: rustc and LLVM preserve the selected Rust/MIR ABI, widths, layout, failure carrier, and target identity under the recorded configuration

foreign_assumptions.edge: canonical MIR artifact to Cranelift IR and resident module
foreign_assumptions.contract: Cranelift preserves declared call conventions, host-word representations, handles, callbacks, trap/failure transport, and completion order

foreign_assumptions.edge: emitted Rust/native object closure to executable or library
foreign_assumptions.contract: the assembler/linker consumes the exact artifact closure and does not change the recorded symbol, layout, or target identity

foreign_assumptions.edge: generated Web Wasm/JavaScript publication to browser or Wasm VM
foreign_assumptions.contract: the named browser/VM honors the generated ABI, linear-memory widths, callback schedule, and resource lifetime

foreign_assumptions.edge: adapter wrapper to crypto, HTTP, font, service, data, and other foreign libraries
foreign_assumptions.contract: the foreign library satisfies its named ABI, encoding, bounds, error, callback, and lifetime contract; its status never proves the Jet wrapper

foreign_assumptions.edge: OS, device, allocator, clock, scheduler, and physical resource providers
foreign_assumptions.contract: the environment satisfies the named target, width, synchronization, capacity, scheduling, and release premises
